page.overview:
Who is Schot?

Schot has a punk appearance, having a mohawk hairstyle and wearing sunglasses and a tattered shirt.

He is a jovial person, but cherishes his well kept mohawk. He is easily angered when people make fun of his hair.

In his youth Schot was part of a British punk band known as "Big B & Bullheads", and all members got along well. Now he works at a record store specializing in punk rock. He also earns pocket money by working as a mook for an organization, where he often causes trouble by getting in fights.

Schot has an average amount of health and deals moderate damage using uppercuts and kicks.
